summary: Adds a new skill file skills/debug-loop/SKILL.md. It defines a debug-loop skill: gather four facts (symptom, repro, check, scope), emit a Debug Brief with ranked hypotheses, take a fast path for trivial bugs, commit a failing test before fixing, instrument runtime values, change one thing at a time, verify by reverting, and reset via a handoff block after two failed fixes. Includes an example brief, gotchas, and pointers to references/tactics.md.

claims.text: Skill supersedes the diagnose skill; when both match, run debug-loop only.
Fast path requires all three conditions: error names file and line, line explains failure, fix touches one place.
Failing test must be committed before any fix, overriding the commit-only-when-asked default.
After two failed fixes on the same issue, stop and write a Debug Handoff block.
/rewind checkpoints track only file-editing-tool edits, not shell command changes.
references/tactics.md contains sections on building a check, git bisect, and overfitting.

risks.note: references/tactics.md and its named sections are cited repeatedly but not present in this chunk.
Claim about /rewind checkpoint behavior stated without source.
Revert-skip rules (check takes minutes, Step 3 proved link) weaken verification with no stated evidence.

least_confident: I could not check whether references/tactics.md exists or whether a diagnose skill exists for the supersedes rule to apply to.
